note: Hebrew massa' is a heading for a prophetic pronouncement ("oracle"), not a "burden" in the sense of a load.

kjv: when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem
mine: and Judah too will be caught up in the siege against Jerusalem
note: The elliptical Hebrew wegam 'al-yehudah yihyeh bammatsor 'al-yerushalayim most naturally says that Judah also will be involved in (or affected by) the siege of Jerusalem; the KJV makes Judah a second target of the besiegers.
